rule: Source fracture surface against the mid-surface of the cavity (Table 2, row 'Mid-surface positioning'), for the label set named in label_set. Per frame (frames): mid = share of the samples on the cavity mid-surface that lie inside the cut solid of their own path (the in-cavity quantity G1 of the label report); S = the same share for the source fracture surface at the same path and station; S_nohit = share at which the source surface does not meet the uncut rock surface. All three are weighted by image length over the visible samples away from the trace tips. Check: mid must equal nontip_inside_fraction of the label report (mid_vs_report_mismatch lists the frames where it does not). Per viewpoint (views; the 10 frames of a block-C viewpoint, which share geometry and camera and differ in illumination and render seed, are pooled): median and range of the frame values. Per group (groups: C, D, E, F and B, each for flat and for standalone ('isolated') outcrops): median and range of the viewpoint medians (mid_view_median, S_view_median, S_nohit_view_median; n is the number of viewpoints with a value and frames the number of frames with a value: in F_flat one of the 8 viewpoints, whose only frame a0113 has no sample, has none), and under pooled the length-weighted share over the frames of the group.
